info.title: VRF
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

aclv4_control_plane_applied.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
Current, successfully applied IPv4 control plane ACL, as identified in aclv4_control_plane_cfg.

aclv4_control_plane_cfg.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
IPv4 ACL, potentially in flight, desired to be applied to control plane traffic, as identified in the ACL. An empty column value indicates that no list is applied for this type and direction.

aclv4_control_plane_cfg_version.description: The version of the 'aclv4_control_plane_cfg' column. This value should be changed to a random value each time any management interface modifies the 'aclv4_control_plane_cfg' value. An empty column value will indicate that the user does not want the system to process this configuration yet.

aclv4_control_plane_statistics.description: This is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. It is available at [ACL](#/ACL).

aclv4_control_plane_status.description: The status of the last version of 'aclv4_control_plane_cfg' column that has been processed.

code.description: Numeric error code. Expected to be 0 when state is 'applied'

message.description: Detailed reason for error state. Expected empty when state is 'applied'

version.description: The version of aclv4_control_plane_cfg that corresponds to this status.

dns_domain_list.description: Domain list names to be used for address resolution, keyed by the  resolution priority order. This column value can be empty.

dns_domain_name.description: Domain name used for name resolution by the DNS client, if `dns_domain_list` is not configured. If both the configurations are not present, name resolution is performed with empty domain suffix. This column value can be empty.

dns_name_servers.description: Name servers to be used for address resolution, keyed by the  resolution priority order

evpn_export_route_targets.description: BGP route targets, formatted as ASN:NN or A.B.C.D:NN, to be sent with the EVPN routes exported from the VRF. Option 'auto' to export auto-generated route-targets from the VRF.

evpn_import_route_targets.description: BGP route targets, formatted as ASN:NN or A.B.C.D:NN, to be matched to the EVPN routes being imported into the VRF. Option 'auto' to import based on auto-generated route-targets into the VRF.

enable.description: When set to `true`, enables inbound HTTPS features including REST API and Web-UI. By default, https_server is enabled on 'mgmt' VRF, disabled on others.

Failed_TCP_Connects.description: Count of TCP connection attempts that have failed on this device.

UDP_pkts_to_unknown_ports.description: Count of UDP packets received on this device and destined to ports that the device is not accepting packets for.

l3vpn_only_enable.description: If the value is `true`, then only L3VPN support is enabled for this VRF.

mgmd_dynamic_groups_joined_count.description: Total number of dynamic Groups joined.  This field value could either be empty or explicitly set to 0 to indicate that the number of dynamic groups joined is 0.

mgmd_groups_joined_count.description: Number of exclude and include Groups joined.  This field value could either be empty or explicitly set to 0 to indicate that the number of include/exclude joined groups is 0.

igmp_exclude_groups.description: Number of groups in Exclude mode for IGMP.

igmp_include_groups.description: Number of groups in Include mode for IGMP.

mld_exclude_groups.description: Number of groups in Exclude mode for MLD.

mld_include_groups.description: Number of groups in Include mode for MLD.

msdp_router.description:
Reference Resource: [MSDP_Router](#/MSDP_Router)
Multicast Source Discovery Protocol Router. If this is not set, MSDP will be disabled on this VRF.

multicast_multipath_hash.description: Hashing algorithm to be used to decide the nexthop when multiple equal cost paths exist to reach a given source address. S-hash : This method uses only the source address to compute the hash to pick the nexthop. S-G-hash : This method uses source and group address in the hash calculation. If not set, the global configuration specified for the system will be used. If set, then it overrides the globally configured value.

Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)

pim_routers.description:

rd.description: Route distinguisher in ASN:nn format or IP:nn format. This is optional.

rip_routers.description:

ripng_routers.description:

snmp_engine_boot_count.description: Represents SNMP engine boot count. This column holds the value of number of times the SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol) agent is restarted. The min value is 1 and it will increment every time SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol) agent is restarted

snmp_engine_up_time.description: SNMP engine uptime in seconds since epoch.

snmp_status.description: This represents SNMP operational status on a VRF.  up - indicates that SNMP is operating on this VRF. down - indicates that SNMP is not operating on this VRF.

authentication_failure.description: Enable sending of SNMP authentication failure traps.

coldstart.description: A coldstart trap will be sent when the switch reboots.

warmstart.description: A warmstart trap will be sent when there is user intervention to enable or disable SNMP service on the switch.
